trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, this is the single-player platinum: earn the other 54 trophies; multiplayer and DLC are not required. Follow the story checkpoints first, then the in-game 100% checklist, and finally the separate stranger strands and remaining trophy conditions.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, Gone Fishing is the first main mission in Chapter 1 and awards this automatically. Complete its objectives during normal story play; it is not an optional or missable unlock.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, the Chapter 1 trophy actually appears after What’s in the Bag?, the first mission of Chapter 2. Before leaving Chapter 1, preserve a manual save and complete Lucia’s balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, this Chapter 2 milestone is awarded after Welcome to Vice City at the start of Chapter 3. Continue the main story; no optional challenge or medal is required.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, this milestone appears after Ocean Beach and Another Life at the start of Chapter 4. Continue the story rather than looking for an extra side objective; this is an automatic unlock.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, Starting From Zero at the end of Chapter 4 awards this milestone. Keep a chapter-boundary manual save because there is no mission replay, although this story trophy itself is not missable.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: From the official description, finish the final mission of the story. PowerPyx calls this automatic, but its current final-mission label conflicts with its five-chapter roadmap, so this guide does not assert a final mission name.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 main mission. Finish the mission objectives for the automatic trophy; optional missions are not a substitute.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, The Cartel Heist is a Chapter 3 main mission. Finish the heist through the story and the trophy follows automatically; a special medal is not required.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, Child’s Play occurs in Chapter 4. Complete the main mission normally; the trophy is automatic rather than a separate challenge.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, Headliners is a Chapter 4 main mission. Complete that mission to receive the automatic unlock; no optional performance target is specified.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, VCIA Takedown belongs to Chapter 4. Finish the main mission; do not confuse this automatic story unlock with the separate passenger-plane trophy at VCIA.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, Operation Savage Glory occurs in Chapter 5. Complete the main mission for the automatic trophy, then continue toward the finale.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, the checklist becomes visible after the story under Progress → Stats → 100% Completion, and earlier progress still counts. Work toward 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 base-model vehicle scans and 100 animal studies; the trophy thresholds alone are not enough. All checklist requirements remain available in post-story free roam.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, any mix of 250 out of 397 stunts works: jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps. Use Progress → Activities → Stunts and the map’s Stunt Spots list to avoid repeating completed entries. Continue to 300 for A Long Road.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, the nine activity types are fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, video games, racing and stunts. Check Progress → Activities and participate in each category once. Normal trophy cleanup covers these, so leave any missing category until your final sweep.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, earn all 42 gold medals across the 12 shooting ranges, not just one medal at each range. Work through the individual challenges and verify each gold result before moving on. This also contributes to the 100% checklist.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, win at each of the 14 Top Fun locations; there are 42 drone races in total. Track locations separately so repeat wins at one venue do not replace another venue. Continue through all 42 races for 100% completion.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, there are 40 unique races and the trophy needs wins in 20 different ones. Record each distinct win rather than repeating a familiar race. These remain available for cleanup after the story.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, Cal sends a text after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, placing a purple fishing marker on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in its challenge. This can be handled alongside the fishing activity rather than a separate exploration sweep.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, finish every level of any one video game; challenge completion is not necessary. Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind can be played using the home TV controllers, while Bang For Your Buck uses arcade machines. Home access may pause during the story but returns afterward.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, Andy calls Lucia in Chapter 3 and then sends her Belville address. Complete her chain through Puff Puff Pass at the warehouse. The quests remain available after the story, so a delayed call does not mean this trophy is lost.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, Kenton’s green KR marker in Key Lento follows Island Dreams in Chapter 1. Recover and return treasures from his seven shipwrecks, using the metal detector underwater. He becomes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns later, and the chain remains completable after the story.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, Billy’s chain appears at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Continue through Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. His trophy is not permanently missable and can be finished after the story.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, finish eight qualifying stranger strands; ordinary optional chains do not all count. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed examples, whereas Andy, Billy and Tyrone do not count toward this specific total. Verify the trophy counter after each finished strand; PowerPyx’s current list of qualifying strangers is incomplete.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ Gs in Chapter 3 introduces Randy and his Key Cloner. Deliver his 16 requested sports cars, checking Map → Robberies → Randy’s Wish List for outstanding models. His RK garage is in western Vice City and deliveries remain available after the story.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, play as Jason after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3 to find Tyrone’s purple Synthetic Lab markers in Vice City. Destroy the labs for Take Out Kitty Litter, then complete Spin On This. This chain remains available after the story.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, after Down to Earth in Chapter 1, talk to Lucia in Jason’s kitchen in the morning; follow her to the balcony and accept meditation before leaving the chapter. Its trophy necessity is unconfirmed: keep a manual save. Track 18 meditations across 10 locations under Progress → Collections → Exploration → Meditations, using both characters. Per Push Square, wait for the final zen animation.
trophies.missableReason: Potentially missable: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason’s house disappears after the chapter. Its necessity for the trophy is unconfirmed (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, Jason receives Bret’s message after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, leading to Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Follow his purple hunting targets and return requested animals to him. The exact animal that triggers this trophy is still unconfirmed; all 15 Target Decks are needed for 100%, and the chain remains available after the story.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx’s card-set guide, finish 3 of 18 sets; A Long Road needs 15 sets. Search indoor surfaces and walls, plus outdoor yellow phone boxes and toolboxes; duplicate cards do not advance a set. Selling cards at pawn shops preserves collection credit, so you can fund other objectives as you collect.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, scan 100 WAiNK objects using any mixture of landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags. The guide lists 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, with tags providing further choices. Keep scanning new locations while travelling rather than revisiting the same objects.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, the trophy needs 50 of the 80 challenges, while the 100% checklist asks for 70. Check Progress → Challenges for the Completed mark and leave deliberate cleanup until other activities have supplied their natural progress. Choose the easiest remaining challenges instead of committing to every one.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, partner free roam unlocks after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Bring your partner, reach four wanted stars and escape the outer red heat zone, not just the immediate search area. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the guide’s suggested escape route; bank-vault work can also supply this naturally.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, bring your partner after Coffee Break and rob three shops while the red/blue wanted pursuit remains active. The three jewelry stores in northern Vice City are a suggested route after Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3. Take loot at each stop and allow about half a minute after the third shop for the unlock; if the first robbery preceded the police response, another shop may be needed.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, scan new vehicles with WAiNK; driving them is unnecessary. A busy road provides varied models, and boats and aircraft also expand the database. Check Progress → Vehicles and continue toward 200 base models for 100% completion.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, prepare focus buffs and line up five gang-operation enemies before activating a single Combat Focus. An accurate automatic rifle helps defeat all five within the same activation; the guide reports soldiers, police and civilians may not count. Improving Focus through shooting ranges and other activities makes the window easier.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, steal a passenger jet attached to a boarding bridge at VCIA, rather than one sitting loose on the airfield. The guide recommends departure gates E3/E4: use the stairs beside the bridge, reach the upstairs cockpit and take off. Fly about one kilometre from the airport before expecting the unlock.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station on the southwestern island in Mariana County. Tanks are in the southern part of the base; enter one and defeat enemies until the trophy appears. The guide suggests the gate or the stunt jump near the southeastern entrance as access routes.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, finish Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to unlock the Snap Gun and jewelry robberies. Enter a store through its back door with the Snap Gun rather than kicking it, then find the safe-code note and empty the safe without detection. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the guide’s suggested store.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, That’s Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4 introduces bank vaults. Tail the security van, enter the open vault while the guard makes the delivery, share the haul with your partner and escape the four-star heat. Five of eight vaults earn this trophy; all eight are needed for 100%.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, the Chapter 4 optional mission That’s Where The Money Is… can award this during its bank robbery and escape. Alternatively, stop an armored truck near a Vice City bank and open its rear doors with a sticky bomb. Escape the red heat radius to finish the condition, rather than stopping after taking the cash.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, clear the fog from the entire Leonida map. Use a plane to cover unexplored regions efficiently and check for remaining dark patches. The PSNProfiles counter tracks 52 areas; no individual area coordinates are asserted here.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, rob at least one illegal operation for each of the nine gangs; there are 39 operations in total. Check Progress → Gangs for each gang’s robbery count and look for yellow map markers. Continue through all 39 when working on the 100% checklist.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: From the official description, the required action is to enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. PowerPyx currently marks the precise trigger as unknown, so this entry does not claim a particular bar, seat or time of day.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, obtain the Key Cloner in Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ Gs during Chapter 3. Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in southern Vice City and drive it through the front window, then continue along the road for the delayed unlock. The guide specifies this car rather than any showroom vehicle.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, take three valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 in the northeast corner and the northeast-hallway safe contents. Bring sticky bombs for the safe and escape the police afterward. Missed valuables can be collected when the robbery respawns, so it is not permanently missable.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, maximize Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Invite your partner to a fitness club: the accompanying character trains while you work out, progressing both together. Check both character sheets rather than assuming one maximum is enough.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, the hidden counter needs 500 actions affecting the criminal profile. Enable Criminal Profile HUD notifications and let robberies, clean escapes and encounters accumulate while pursuing other trophies. Verify progress in the trophy tracker; a specific moral alignment is not required.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: From the official description, the clue points to a second attempt being significant. PowerPyx marks the trigger unknown, so no mission, location or retry sequence is presented as a confirmed solution.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: From the official description, an unexplained event is the only stated clue. PowerPyx marks the exact trigger unknown; this guide does not turn speculation about a UFO quest into a required step.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: From the official description, knock a target over with a melee drive-by. PowerPyx has not confirmed the exact trigger, so this entry does not claim a particular vehicle, weapon or location.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, Credit Check in Chapter 3 unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer used for marked bills. Bring robbery proceeds to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most according to the guide. The $250,000 is cumulative across deliveries, not a single required load.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, spending is cumulative across shop types. Weapons, vehicle modifications and tattoos are useful high-cost purchases, so combine this with equipment you need for other trophies. Check the $100,000 total before buying anything purely for the trophy.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, buy the eight purchasable garages; the four story garages do not replace them. Daily Driver in Chapter 2 unlocks the Vice City Real Estate phone app used to buy them. The listed total price is $160,000, and later robberies can fund the purchases.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx, the Chapter 2 mission Moses installs Scooter Bros and introduces Moses’s garage in Port Gellhorn. Buy enough parking capacity, then take eligible vehicles there and select Respray and Register until ten are registered. Early on use vehicles without trackers; Chapter 3 later expands registration options.
trophies.missableReason: No permanent missable flag in PowerPyx’s current roadmap; unresolved triggers remain explicitly marked.

research.note: Official strings preserved from the kit. PowerPyx launch guide researched directly; uncertain conditions identified, not invented. Hidden flags cross-checked against TrueTrophies.
